column1: # GENERATED by Tools/aloop_salience_fit.pl - never hand-edited. A-LOOP q5 (docs/specs/A_LOOP_PLAN.md section 6 (3)): every Eurobarometer

# source rows: wave, stored file, its SHA-256, the fieldwork its sheet prints, the sheet, the fieldwork's midpoint (days since 1970-01-01).
# row rows: class, unit (the country), step (-1 the pre-wave, 0 the post-wave, k the k-th decay wave), wave, the wave's date, the share
# (0..1, the sheet's figure; the larger of the class's items where it reads two), the weighted total the sheet prints for the country,
# base rows (K69, the USA's conversion): wave, member, the sum of every QA3 share its sheet prints for the member (the mentions a
# respondent gives; the French duplicate of the Cyprus item left out), the count of items summed.
# gallupsource row: the stored Gallup table (ElectionsData/usa/raw/salience/), its SHA-256; gallup rows: a month, its Total row (0..).
